book.peqol.title: Alchemist's Handbook
book.peqol.page1:
§5§lProjectE QoL+§r

Alchemy without the chores.

This book lists every tool, charm, block, keybind and command of the addon.

§7Type /peqol help in chat for the command list.
book.peqol.page2:
§5§lHUD & Keys§r

§lJ§r open transmutation
§lB§r open alchemical bag
§lH§r toggle EMC HUD

Unbound (Controls menu): quick burn, learn inventory and one toggle per charm.

Middle click: alchemical pick block.
book.peqol.page3:
§5§lTooltips§r

Hold §lSHIFT§r over an item:
- how many you can create
- sell value
- full stack value
- shulker contents EMC

Looking at a machine shows a small info panel next to the crosshair.
book.peqol.page4:
§5§lCharms I§r

Right click to toggle.

§lRestocker§r refills hotbar blocks, enables pick block, remakes broken tools and powers /peqol autostock.

§lSiphon§r turns filtered pickups and mob drops into EMC.
book.peqol.page5:
§5§lCharms II§r

§lMending§r repairs gear with EMC.
§lSatiation§r eats a chosen food.
§lStellar Link§r charges Klein Stars.
§lIllumination§r places torches.
§lSmelting§r smelts picked ores.

All work in Curios slots.
book.peqol.page6:
§5§lTools§r

§lConstruction Wand§r extends faces (sneak+air: size).
§lAppraisal Lens§r values containers; sneak twice to burn them.
§lPhilosopher's Wrench§r picks up machines with their EMC.
§lProspector§r scans ores.
book.peqol.page7:
§5§lTravel & Storage§r

§lAlchemical Anchor§r: sneak+click a block to anchor, right click to teleport for EMC.
§l/peqol back§r returns to your death point.
§lVoid Pouch§r: ender chest anywhere.
§lPocket Workbench§r: crafting anywhere.
book.peqol.page8:
§5§lAutomation I§r

Machines belong to whoever places them.

§lUplink§r: collectors and relays to personal EMC.
§lDownlink§r: personal EMC to relays.
§lImporter§r: hopper items become EMC.
§lVacuum§r: sucks dropped items.
book.peqol.page9:
§5§lAutomation II§r

§lExporter§r creates items from EMC into chests. Right click with an item: unlimited. Sneak + right click with N items: keep N in stock.

§lGauge§r: comparator signal = digits of your EMC.

Redstone pauses machines.
book.peqol.page10:
§5§lEconomy§r

§l/peqol pay§r send EMC
§l/peqol withdraw§r EMC cheques
§l/peqol gift§r items to others
§lKnowledge Scroll§r shares what you learned.

Amounts accept 1.5k, 20M, 3B.
book.peqol.page11:
§5§lCommands§r

buy, sell, value, known (click to buy), learnall, unlearned, missing, worth, burn, autostock, stars, xp, stats, top, back.

§7All start with /peqol
book.peqol.page12:
§5§lTips§r

- Use /peqol learnall to learn everything cheaply.
- Restocker + autostock = never run out of torches.
- Wrench condensers to move them.

§7Lost this book? /peqol handbook

jei.peqol.info.restocker_talisman: Keep it active in your inventory: hotbar blocks are refilled from personal EMC, middle click creates blocks you don't carry, broken learned tools are remade, and /peqol autostock entries are kept topped up.
jei.peqol.info.siphon_charm: Sneak + right click with an item in the other hand to add it to the filter. While active, picked up or mob-dropped items in the filter turn straight into personal EMC.
jei.peqol.info.mending_charm: While active, damaged tools and armor in your inventory are repaired using personal EMC. A full repair costs about the item's EMC value.
jei.peqol.info.satiation_charm: Sneak + right click with a learned food in the other hand to choose it. While active, it is eaten automatically (paid with EMC) whenever no hunger would be wasted.
jei.peqol.info.stellar_link: While active, Klein Stars in your inventory and Curios slots are charged from your personal EMC every second.
jei.peqol.info.illumination_charm: While active, a torch is placed at your feet whenever it gets dark. Torches come from your inventory first, then personal EMC.
jei.peqol.info.construction_wand: Right click a block face to place copies on every connected block of the same kind (1 to 81). Sneak + right click in the air to change the size. Shows a preview outline.
jei.peqol.info.appraisal_lens: Right click a container to see its EMC value, or an EMC block to see what it stores. Right click in the air for your inventory. Sneak + right click a container twice to burn its contents.
jei.peqol.info.alchemical_anchor: Sneak + right click a block to anchor that spot. Right click to teleport back, paying EMC based on distance (more across dimensions).
jei.peqol.info.smelting_charm: While active, ores and raw materials you pick up arrive already smelted, for a small EMC fee per item.
jei.peqol.info.emc_cheque: Created with /peqol withdraw. Holds personal EMC as a tradeable item. Right click to redeem.
jei.peqol.info.knowledge_scroll: Right click to record everything you have learned. Another player right clicks it to learn all of it.
jei.peqol.info.alchemical_uplink: Place next to Energy Collectors or Anti-Matter Relays: the EMC they send goes straight into the owner's personal EMC.
jei.peqol.info.alchemical_importer: Items inserted by hoppers or pipes become the owner's personal EMC and are learned. Items without EMC are refused.
jei.peqol.info.alchemical_exporter: Right click with an item to export it. It is created from the owner's EMC into adjacent inventories. Sneak + right click with N items to keep exactly N in stock.
jei.peqol.info.alchemical_vacuum: Collects dropped items around it and turns them into the owner's personal EMC. Optional filter by right clicking with items.
jei.peqol.info.alchemical_downlink: Draws the owner's personal EMC and pushes it into adjacent relays, collectors and other EMC blocks.
jei.peqol.info.philosophers_wrench: Sneak + right click a ProjectE machine to pick it up with its EMC, inventory and settings.
jei.peqol.info.alchemical_gauge: Gives a comparator signal equal to the number of digits of the owner's personal EMC (up to 15).
jei.peqol.info.pocket_workbench: Right click to open a crafting table anywhere.
jei.peqol.info.void_pouch: Right click to open your ender chest anywhere, for a small EMC fee.
jei.peqol.info.prospector: Right click to scan the ores around you and see their total EMC value.

jei.peqol.info.machine_upgrade: Right click an Alchemical Exporter, Vacuum or Downlink (that you own) to raise its tier, up to 3. Each tier makes the machine faster and stronger, and the tier is kept when wrenched.

jei.peqol.info.alchemical_interface: Turns your transmutation knowledge into a virtual inventory. Every learned item shows up as a slot (count = how many you can afford). Pipes, hoppers and storage mods (AE2 storage bus, Refined Storage external storage) can pull items, which are created from the owner's EMC, and insert items, which are burned. Works while the owner is online.

Other players right click with an empty hand to buy one (sneak: a whole stack), paying with their personal EMC. Earnings go to you, or wait for you if you are offline.

jei.peqol.info.alchemical_excavator: Mines a square area below itself (9x9 by default) down to bedrock, paying a little EMC per block. Drops with EMC become the owner's personal EMC, the rest goes into an adjacent chest (or pops out on top). Skips blocks with inventories, fluids and unbreakable blocks, respects protections. Needs the owner online, redstone pauses it, sneak + empty hand restarts it. Accepts Machine Upgrades, and Silk Touch / Fortune enchanted books (right click).

Produce with EMC becomes the owner's personal EMC while they are online; everything else goes into an adjacent chest. Upgrades add radius, redstone pauses it.
